sources.scope: Derive one real smooth sequence with common outer compact support and simultaneous actual ordinary-volume L2 function/gradient/Laplacian limits for v=chi*u, g=chi*G+u*gradientchi, F=chi*r+2inner(gradientchi,G)+u*laplacianchi. Same original D before epsilon/f, same u before ALL cutoffs. No supplied graph-density/approximation/mixedHessian/core certificate, no classical rough derivatives, no weighted-domain/operator-core/globalcutoff/Bochner/BL/Poincare/jointmeasurablechoice/main/composition claim. Reflected/RGO quarter Hessian and fourfold energy kept distinct; TV never transfers unbounded cost.

assumptions: Same finite real Hilbert/Borel/canonical-volume structure including dimension zero. V is C2, alpha/beta NNReal, 0<alpha<=beta, all-point/all-vector alpha I<=Hess V<=beta I; eta>0 and beta*eta<=1.

True augmentation J=(x,x+sqrt(eta)*xi)#(mu*standardGaussian), common actual disintegrating probability kernels R/S, S_y=(2x-y)#R_y=volume.tilted(-W_y), W_y(z)=V((y+z)/2)+norm(z-y)^2/(8eta), and actual positive integrable partitions are derived from accepted parents. Reflected/RGO laws/operators and quarter Hessian/fourfold Dirichlet scaling remain distinct.

Original dense closable compact-smooth gradient D_y with closed closure is fixed before epsilon/forcing. For every epsilon>0 and f in L2(S_y), choose ONE actual u before ALL C2 compact cutoffs chi. Derive the actual v=chi*u, Gchi=chi*D.closure(u)+u*gradientchi and Fchi=chi*r+2inner(gradientchi,D.closure(u))+u*Deltachi, r=epsilon*u+inner(gradientW,D.closure(u))-f; all required volumeL2/support/weak equations are genuine parent conclusions.
units.statement: Construct common R/S; for each y fix original D_y before epsilon/f, choose ONE u before ALL C2 compact chi. Retain original exact D graph, dense/closable/closed properties, all-domain positive-epsilon variational identity, ordinary locally integrable u/G, all-C1 compact directional weak-gradient identities, local squared-r integrability, compact-volumeL2 of u/G/r, original all-C2 PDE, and all actual localized volumeL2/support/first/second weak identities. The actual volumeL2 properties are retained; actual vL/FL/gradL quotient classes are returned with all three AE links and bind the simultaneous limits. For each cutoff apply the shared actual producer: Derive one real Schwartz sequence phi_n with one common outer compact Kprime containing every tsupport(phi_n), chosen before all n and all three limits. Actual volumeL2 classes of phi_n converge to v; actual classical gradient(phi_n) is MemLp2 and its class converges to the actual Gchi; actual Laplacian(phi_n) classes converge to Fchi. Every phi_n is C-infinity and compactly supported. The same sequence realizes all limits. Kprime need not equal K. No classical derivatives of rough v, real Hessian family, quantitative source complexity constant or weighted operator core is claimed.
units.formula: \exists R,S\ \forall y\ \exists D_y\ \forall\varepsilon>0,f\ \exists u\ \forall\chi\in C_c^2\ \exists K\prime,(\varphi_n):\quad(\varphi_n,\nabla\varphi_n,\Delta\varphi_n)\to(\chi u,\chi G+u\nabla\chi,F_\chi)\ \text{in ordinary }L^2.
